If quality_feedback is present, correct every listed issue in this attempt. Flag uncertain or guideline-dependent claims in the answer for faculty verification. Every prompt must end in '?' or ':'. Exactly one correct MCQ option. Follow requested_card_mix exactly where possible and return exactly requested_card_count cards. For MCQs use 4-5 plausible options, one unambiguous key, and explain why the key is correct and why distractors are wrong. Clinical cases must include age/context, focused findings, a reasoning question and a safe first-step approach; avoid unsupported drug doses. Viva answers should be structured and exam-ready. OSCE cards need candidate instructions, expected steps and a concise checklist rubric. Include red flags, differential diagnosis, investigations and management principles when relevant to the objective. Use original wording; do not copy textbook passages. evidence_status must be unreviewed.
